# CopyButton props

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string \| (readonly string[] & string)` | required | The string value to be copied to the clipboard when the button is clicked. |
| `children` | `(state: { copied: boolean; }) => ReactNode` | — | Render prop function that receives the copied state object and returns custom ReactNode for button content. If not provided, a default icon/UI is rendered, unless `render` is set. |
| `timeout` | `number` | `2000` | How long, in milliseconds, the copied state shows after a successful copy. Each copy restarts it. |
| `labels` | `Partial<CopyButtonLabels>` | — | Replaces the built-in English strings, e.g. to translate them. Keys you leave out keep the default from `DEFAULT_COPY_BUTTON_LABELS`. `aria-label` takes precedence. With `children`, the button has no default name, so `labels` does not apply. The content names the button then, so icon-only children need an `aria-label`. |

## Labels

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `copy` | `string` | `"Copy to clipboard"` | Name of the button before a copy. |
| `copied` | `string` | `"Copied"` | Name of the button while it shows the copied state. |
